integrity: The exact size formula is proved from weighted binary rotation orbits and independently replayed on finite prime anchors. Literature comparison distinguishes direct q-ary DVT cardinalities from parity-lifted ternary classes.
limitations: The exact formula is for the ternary parity-lift construction and is not a global optimum for all ternary two-burst-deletion covering codes.
The proof assumes odd prime length; composite lengths are not claimed.
The all-length covering property uses Xie--Sun--Ge Theorem VI.4, while direct exhaustive covering verification is supplied only for \(p\in\{3,5,7\}\).
title: Exact syndrome sizes for ternary parity-lifted two-burst covering codes
